title: Priya Prem v. Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Ltd. & 4 Others
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf & Yogendra Kumar Srivastava, JJ.
disposition: Writ petition disposed of; petitioner directed to approach the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum
headnote: A grievance seeking issuance of a new electricity connection under s.43 of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Clauses 4.4 and 7.7.2 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 (including a claim for penalty under s.43(3) for delay), and a demand for constitution of a Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum under the UPERC (Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum) Regulations, 2022, is to be routed through the existing/designated Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum by way of a representation, to be decided expeditiously after a hearing, rather than adjudicated directly by the writ court.

holding_units.code: Electricity Act, 2003 (s.43) read with U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 (Clauses 4.4, 7.7.2) and UPERC (Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum) Regulations, 2022 (Clauses 3.2, 3.12)
holding_units.topic: A new-connection grievance (including a s.43(3) penalty claim) is routed through the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum rather than decided directly in writ jurisdiction
holding_units.question: Should a writ court directly decide a new-connection/penalty grievance under s.43 EA2003 and Clauses 4.4/7.7.2 of the Supply Code, or should the consumer be relegated to the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum?
holding_units.holding: The petitioner was directed to file a representation before the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum (presided over by the Sub Divisional Officer, Electricity Urban Distribution, Sub Division-IX Raptinagar, Gorakhpur) within two weeks; the Forum was directed to decide the representation within four weeks of receipt, by a reasoned order after affording the petitioner a hearing.
holding_units.limiting_facts: The petitioner sought a mandamus directing issuance of a new electricity connection (application dated 15.4.2024 pending), payment of a s.43(3) delay penalty, and constitution of a district-level Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum under the 2022 CGRF Regulations.

principle_tags.application: Companion application of the CGRF-routing principle already tracked in this corpus (SCJ-076, SCJ-096) — new-connection and delay-penalty grievances under s.43/Clause 4.4/7.7.2 are likewise routed through the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum rather than decided directly by the writ court.

not_decided.point: Merits of the new-connection application and s.43(3) penalty claim
not_decided.note: Not decided; left to the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum.
